newsitem.title: CHINA: China to send first troops to HK in new uniforms.
newsitem.headline: China to send first troops to HK in new uniforms.

text.p: The first Chinese troops to march into Hong Kong when the British colony reverts to Beijing rule this year will form the vanguard of a fashion revolution in the People's Liberation Army, officials said on Wednesday.
China's three-million-strong army is changing out of its 1988 uniform, known as Style-87, and into new styles with new colours and new hats, a spokesman for the Ministry of National Defence said.
"The old uniform was not suitable," the official said.
The changes would allow for greater flexibility in the uniform, he said.
For example, the uniform would now include a Western-style jacket for the first time as well as a beret.
"We have absorbed some good things from Western armies," the official said.

China began designing a new generation of uniforms for use into the 21st century in early 1993, and the new uniforms to be used by the troops in Hong Kong are a result of that research, state media said.
The troops to be stationed in Hong Kong will wear the new uniforms as they march into Hong Kong when China recovers the territory on July 1 after 156 years as a British colony, officials said.
China will start to use the new uniforms for the entire armed forces around 2000 -- if conditions are right, the logistics department said.
